results.title: PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk (EMTK) strengthens its position in PT Bukalapak.com Tbk (BUKA) and PT Nitrasanata Dharma Tbk (JECX)
results.body: The BEI disclosed on 22 Sep that PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk (EMTK) increased its holdings in PT Bukalapak.com Tbk (BUKA) by 188.70 million shares, raising its stake to 10.67%, and added 1.17 million shares of PT Nitrasanata Dharma Tbk (JECX) through its health subsidiary PT Sarana Meditama Metropolitan Tbk (SAME), bringing its total shareholdings to 33%. PT Yulie Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk (YULE) raised its stake in PT Esa Medika Mandiri Tbk (EMMI) to about 10.19%; Samudra (Investment) Pte. Ltd boosted its holding in PT Mitra Adiperkasa Tbk (MAPI) to 30.19%; and Lo Kheng Hong increased his position in PT Intiland Development Tbk (DILD) to 7.54%. Edwin Soeryadjaya now controls 35.95% of PT Saratoga Investama Sedaya Tbk (SRTG), Ferry Sudjono holds roughly 6.02% of PT Fore Kopi Indonesia Tbk (FORE), while Dato Tahir reduced his stake in PT Maha Properti Indonesia Tbk (MPRO) to 10.46%. PT Global Mediacom Tbk (BMTR) sold 28.90 million shares of its subsidiary PT Media Nusantara Citra Tbk (MNCN), lowering its control to 38.23%, and The Bank of New York Mellon divested 6 million shares of PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM), retaining about 6.3% of the telecom firm.

results.title: MNC Sekuritas forecasts IHSG rise and recommends top-performing stocks on 24 Sep 2026
results.body: MNC Sekuritas noted that the IHSG closed up 1.56% at 6,374.91 on 23 Sep 2026 and projected the index to test support levels 6,208-6,258 before targeting a near-term strength zone of 6,387-6,418, with support at 6,267 and 6,108 and resistance at 6,440-6,535. The LQ45 gainers were PT Indika Energy Tbk (INDY) (+10.04%), PT Darma Henwa Tbk (DEWA) (+9.20%) and PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk (MDKA) (+8.83%), with additional advances from PT Hartadinata Abadi Tbk (HRTA) (+5.99%), PT Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI) (+4.89%) and PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk (MBMA) (+3.96%). The biggest decliners were PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Tbk (CPIN) (-1.91%), PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM) (-1.21%), PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk (PGAS) (-1.03%), PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) (-0.63%), PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk (EMTK) (-0.45%) and PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk (ITMG) (-0.40%). The broker recommended buying on weakness PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (EMAS) and PT Vktr Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk (VKTR), and buying PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (CUAN) and PT Indika Energy Tbk (INDY).

results.title: PT Kreatif Media Karya increases its stake in PT Bukalapak.com Tbk to 45.68%
results.body: PT Kreatif Media Karya, the controlling shareholder of PT Bukalapak.com Tbk, increased its ownership to 45.68% by buying additional shares. On 4 September 2026 it purchased 803,287,800 shares at Rp126 each, costing about Rp101.21 billion and raising its holding to 47,125,034,185 shares out of 46,321,746,385 total shares. The filing also shows that PT Elang Mahkota and PT Bukalapak each hold over 10% of PT Bukalapak.com Tbk’s shares, with 10,821,706,040 (10.48%) and 11,333,437,507 (10.986%) shares respectively. Following the transaction, PT Bukalapak.com Tbk’s shares closed at 113 on 7 September, down 1.74% (‑2 points), and the stock carries a special notation I.

results.title: Investment holding issuers report weak H1 2026 performance amid portfolio losses
results.body: The article reports that major Indonesian investment holding companies posted deteriorated results in the first semester of 2026 due to market volatility affecting their equity portfolios. PT Provident Investasi Bersama Tbk recorded a net investment loss of IDR 670.61 billion and a net loss attributable to owners of IDR 881.69 billion, reversing a profit of IDR 587.36 billion a year earlier. PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk posted a net investment loss of IDR 2.28 trillion and a net loss of IDR 289.69 billion, compared with profits of IDR 1.31 trillion and IDR 4.25 trillion respectively in the same period of 2025. PT Saratoga Investama Sedaya Tbk saw net investment losses rise to IDR 4.83 trillion and a net loss of IDR 3.87 trillion, while PT Astra International Tbk reported a fair‑value loss on other investments of IDR 837 billion and an additional IDR 259 billion loss on group equity investments. The firms said they will maintain long‑term investment strategies and aim for a turnaround in semester II 2026.

results.title: IHSG opens higher as market concerns ease
results.body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) opened stronger on 28 August 2026 as easing market concerns lifted sentiment. At 09:01 the index rose 13.96 points, or 0.21%, to 6,535, with trading volume of about 3 billion shares and a transaction value of Rp1.3 trillion. Brokers highlighted several stocks for the session, naming EXCL, INET, HRUM (BRI Danareksa), BMRI, BBNI, INDY, CUAN, MBMA (Phintraco), ISAT, AADI, ADMR, ARCI, BBRI, BBNI (CGS International), and PANI, EMTK, ERAA (Panin Sekuritas) as preferred picks. Analysts projected the index to trade within support levels of 6,360‑6,400 and resistance of 6,600‑6,630, noting a technical rebound from the 20‑day moving average at 6,359 and positive MACD momentum.

results.title: Daily stock recommendation roundup for 28 August 2026
results.body: The article provides a summary of stock recommendations for 28 August 2026. The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed at 6,521, up 1.81%, after reaching an intraday low of 6,376, with a trading volume of 36.76 billion shares and a transaction value of Rp13.69 trillion. Industrial, non‑primary consumer, and health sectors led the market, posting gains of 3.94%, 3.79% and 3.75% respectively, while buying pressure dominated the trade flow. Recommended stocks include EXCL, INET, HRUM, KETR, PSAB, TOBA, DMAS, BIPI, KOTA, BUMI, SLIS, DEWA, ENRG, ICBP, PTRO, ISAT, AADI, ADMR, ARCI, BBRI, BBNI, BMRI, INDY, CUAN, MBMA, PANI, EMTK, ERAA, BKSL and LSIP.

results.title: Emtek sells 99.99% of PT Abhimata Citra Abadi, ending its subsidiary status
results.body: Emtek announced the sale of virtually all its shares in PT Abhimata Citra Abadi, removing the company from its consolidated financial statements. The transaction, effective 20 August 2026 and disclosed on 24 August 2026, transferred 100,090 shares representing 99.99% of ACA’s paid‑up capital, valued at Rp 10,009 billion, to former director Yuslinda Nasution. Emtek said the divestment is part of a strategic portfolio optimisation and will not have material negative impact on its operations or financial condition. Following the announcement, EMTK shares fell 1.9% to Rp 515.

results.title: Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk expands AI use to improve efficiency and competitiveness
results.body: PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk (EMTK) said it is expanding artificial‑intelligence applications across its media and health services to enhance efficiency and competitiveness, citing the VidioGen platform that cuts production time and cost by about 30%. For the first half of 2026 the company reported net revenue of Rp10.81 trillion, up 22.74% YoY, but posted a loss attributable to its parent owners of Rp320.60 billion after a profit of Rp4.22 trillion in the same period a year earlier.

results.title: EMTK sells 99.99% of PT Abhimata Citra Abadi shares to Yuslinda Nasution
results.body: PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk (EMTK) transferred its ownership of PT Abhimata Citra Abadi (ACA) to Yuslinda Nasution, effectively divesting its IT business line. The transaction involved 100,090 ACA shares with a nominal value of Rp10,009 billion, representing 99.99% of ACA's paid‑up capital. EMTK’s corporate secretary Titi Maria Rusli said the sale is part of the company’s strategy to optimise its investment structure and portfolio management. ACA, founded in 1989, provides a wide range of telecom infrastructure services, including wireline, broadband, VSAT and IoT solutions.

results.title: PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk sells 99.99% of PT Abhimata Citra Abadi to former director Yuslinda Nasution
results.body: PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk (EMTK) sold its controlling stake in PT Abhimata Citra Abadi (ACA) to former director Yuslinda Nasution. The transaction transferred 100,090 shares with a nominal value of Rp10,009 billion, representing 99.99% of ACA’s paid‑up capital, effective 24 August 2026. Control of ACA shifted to Yuslinda, and ACA will no longer be consolidated in EMTK’s financial statements. EMTK indicated the sale does not materially affect its operations, legal standing, financial condition, or business continuity. Yuslinda, who resigned from EMTK’s board on 29 May 2026, will serve as President Director of ACA.

results.title: Emtek Group (EMTK) sells 99.99% of subsidiary PT Abhimata Citra Abadi to former director Yuslinda Nasution
results.body: Emtek Group (PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk) announced the sale of its entire stake in telecommunications subsidiary PT Abhimata Citra Abadi to former director Yuslinda Nasution. The transaction transferred 100,090 shares with a nominal value of Rp10,009 billion, representing 99.99% of ACA’s paid‑up capital, and was executed by a share purchase deed dated 20 August 2026 before notary Stephanie Wilamarta SH. Following the sale, direct control of ACA passes to Yuslinda Nasution and ACA will no longer be consolidated in EMTK’s financial statements. EMTK stated the divestment is part of its portfolio‑optimization strategy and does not have a material adverse effect on its operations, legal standing, financial condition, or business continuity.

results.title: EMTK sells 99.99% of subsidiary PT Abhimata Citra Abadi to former director Yuslinda Nasution
results.body: PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk (EMTK) sold its entire stake in subsidiary PT Abhimata Citra Abadi (ACA), transferring 100,090 shares that represent 99.99% ownership to former EMTK director Yuslinda Nasution on 20 August 2026. The transaction was executed before a notary and was announced to the Indonesia Stock Exchange on 24 August 2026. EMTK stated that the divestiture will not have a material adverse effect on its operations, legal standing, financial condition, or business continuity. Consequently, ACA will no longer be consolidated in EMTK’s financial statements and will continue operating in the telecommunications technology sector.

results.title: IHSG projected to rise toward 6,544 ahead of the weekend
results.body: The article forecasts that Indonesia’s composite index (IHSG) could continue its upward momentum on Friday, potentially reaching 6,544 in the best‑case scenario. MNC Sekuritas analyst Herditya Wicaksana outlines support zones at 6,296 and 6,201 and resistance at 6,599 and 6,763, while also warning of a downside correction to 6,056‑6,230 if the index fails. Binaartha Sekuritas analyst Ivan Rosanova expects the index to test a key resistance at 6,545, with upside to 6,666 if breached and downside if the level holds, citing support at 6,338, 6,230, 6,057 and 5,887. Both analysts recommend the stocks ARCI, BIPI, NCKL, RMKE, ADMR, BRPT, EMTK and INCO as potential beneficiaries of the projected move.

results.title: Big‑cap stocks and a stronger rupiah drove the IHSG higher on 20 August 2026
results.body: On Thursday 20 August 2026 the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed at 6,501.58, up 1.68% (107.46 points) as big‑cap stocks and a firmer rupiah propelled the market. The rally was broad, with 452 advancing stocks versus 190 declining, and sector gains led by raw‑material, non‑primary consumer and industrial shares. PT Hartadinata Abadi Tbk rose 7.83%, PT Kalbe Farma Tbk 5.77%, PT Surya Citra Media Tbk 5.77%, PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk 4.76% and PT Aneka Tambang Tbk 3.63%, providing major weight to the index. The rupiah strengthened to Rp17,746 per US$ (up 0.49%) while the Dollar Index fell to 98,574, supporting the equity gains.

results.title: IHSG projected to move within a narrow range on Wednesday 19 August, with stock recommendations for BYAN, BRMS, EMAS, PGEO, TAPG, EMTK, ADRO and BWPT
results.body: The article forecasts that Indonesia’s composite index (IHSG) will trade in a limited range on Wednesday 19 August, citing technical support around 6,400–6,430 and resistance near 6,490‑6,465. Analysts note the previous day’s 0.75% gain to 6,449.83, driven by a 7.10% rise in the energy sector and a roughly 20% jump in BYAN amid acquisition sentiment. They recommend buying BRMS (target IDR 695‑725), PGEO (IDR 1,160‑1,205), TAPG (IDR 1,890‑1,945), EMTK (IDR 530‑550), ADRO (IDR 2,600‑2,700) and BWPT (IDR 97‑100). The outlook is framed by upcoming events such as the Bank Indonesia rate decision (expected to stay at 5.75%), the RDG meeting, and the release of FOMC minutes, which could influence market direction.

results.title: IHSG Vulnerable to Profit Taking; Analysts Recommend Selected Stocks for Wednesday (19 Aug)
results.body: The article warns that the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) is susceptible to profit‑taking ahead of the Bank Indonesia rate decision and upcoming FOMC minutes. It notes that IHSG closed up 47,942 points (0.75%) at 6,449.83 with a trading volume of 33.66 billion shares worth Rp 14.83 trillion. Analyst Herditya Wicaksana of MNC Sekuritas recommends buying BRMS (target Rp 695‑725), PGEO (target Rp 1,160‑1,205) and TAPG (target Rp 1,890‑1,945). Analyst Reza Diofanda of BRI Danareksa Sekuritas recommends EMTK (target Rp 530‑550), ADRO (target Rp 2,600‑2,700) and BWPT (target Rp 97‑100).

results.title: IHSG closes up 0.75% at 6,449, becoming top performer in Asian markets driven by energy and big‑cap stock gains
results.body: The article explains why the Indonesian composite index (IHSG) closed higher and topped Asian exchanges on 18 August 2026. IHSG rose 0.75% to 6,449, touched a high of 6,490, with 33.65 billion shares traded (value Rp 14.83 trillion) and outperformed regional peers such as KLCI (+0.43%) and Ho Chi Minh (+0.26%). Gains were led by energy (+2.24%), infrastructure (+1.65%) and transportation (+1.42%) stocks, notably PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk up 9.56%, PT Indika Energy Tbk up 5.08%, PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk up 3.18%, PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk up 2.98%, PT Indosat Tbk up 2.36% and PT Mitra Adiperkasa Tbk up 2.01%. The rally was supported by expectations that Bank Indonesia will keep the BI Rate at 5.75% in the upcoming RDG, with technical analysis showing the index above its 20‑day moving average and likely to trade sideways between 6,400 and 6,500.

results.title: Stock Recommendations and IHSG Movement for August 11, 2026
results.body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) slipped 0.69% to 6,365.37 on August 11, 2026, trading between 6,462.74 and 6,362.76. Among LQ45 constituents, PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk, PT Barito Pacific Tbk, PT Indika Energy Tbk, PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk, PT Indosat Tbk and PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk led declines of 3‑4%, while PT ESSA Industries Indonesia Tbk, PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk, PT Hartadinata Abadi Tbk, PT United Tractors Tbk, PT Mitra Adiperkasa Tbk and PT Bukit Asam Tbk posted gains ranging from 0.8% to 7.9%. MNC Sekuritas recommended buying on weakness PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk, PT ESSA Industries Indonesia Tbk and PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk, and a trading‑buy position for PT Hartadinata Abadi Tbk. The broker highlighted support at 6,319‑6,201 and resistance at 6,454‑6,599, indicating limited upside pending macro developments.

results.title: PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk reports 80.24% surge in digital revenue but posts Rp320.6 billion loss in H1 2026
results.body: PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk (EMTK) posted a loss attributable to its parent owners of Rp320.60 billion for the first half of 2026, reversing a profit of Rp4.23 trillion a year earlier, with loss per share of Rp5.25 versus profit per share of Rp69.26. Total revenue rose 22.70% to Rp10.81 trillion, driven by an 80.24% increase in digital services revenue to Rp3.99 trillion. Advertising revenue fell 1.41% to Rp2.41 trillion, while other segments such as warehousing, health services, and subscription services posted modest gains, and VSAT services declined sharply by 82.28%. On the balance sheet, assets declined 1.46% to Rp59.88 trillion, cash fell 11.46% to Rp19.85 trillion, liabilities rose 7.05% to Rp7.90 trillion, and equity decreased 2.64% to Rp51.98 trillion.

results.title: Assessing Conglomerate Stock Prospects After First‑Half 2026 Performance
results.body: The article evaluates the outlook of Indonesian conglomerate‑listed stocks following their first‑half 2026 results. PT Indofood Sukses Makmur Tbk reported revenue of Rp 65.53 trillion (+9% YoY) but net profit fell 19% to Rp 4.72 trillion; PT PP London Sumatra Indonesia Tbk saw sales rise 16% YoY with net profit up 25% YoY; PT Barito Pacific Tbk posted a 71.6% revenue increase to US$5.69 billion while net profit dropped 64.8% to US$190 million; and PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk grew revenue 22.7% YoY to Rp 10.81 trillion yet recorded a loss of Rp 4.23 trillion. Other highlighted conglomerates include DCII, TOWR, BREN, AALI, SCMA, CUAN, DMAS, SUPA, BUMI, ICBP, ROTI, IMAS, ASII, UNTR, BSDE, BUKA, AUTO, BBCA, SRTG and TPIA, with analysts pointing to data‑center and digital‑infrastructure firms (DCII, TOWR), renewable‑energy player BREN, and plantation companies AALI and LSIP as having the strongest growth potential. Kiwoom Securities’ Liza Camelia Suryanata and Pilarmas Investindo’s Maximilianus Nico Demus each issued target‑price recommendations, notably ASII at Rp 6,580, INDF at Rp 8,420, ICBP at Rp 9,760, SRTG at Rp 2,850, BBCA at Rp 8,130 (Liza’s 12‑month target Rp 8,075), AUTO at Rp 3,270 and TPIA at Rp 3,190 per share. The analysts caution that margin pressure, funding costs, commodity‑price volatility and limited free‑float valuations could temper upside, but they expect conglomerates’ diversified business models to sustain resilience through 2026.
